mapper.select: SELECT sp.id AS studentProfileId, sp.student_no AS studentNo, sp.real_name AS studentName, ao.id AS offeringId, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ao.title_override), ''), at.title) AS name, at.description_md AS description, sa.submission_status AS status, COALESCE(sa.best_total_score, sa.latest_total_score) AS score, COALESCE(sa.last_submit_at, sa.first_submit_at) AS submitTime FROM student_profile sp JOIN class_student cs ON cs.student_num COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = sp.student_no COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci JOIN teaching_class tc ON tc.id = cs.class_id AND (tc.status IS NULL OR tc.status = 'ACTIVE') JOIN assignment_offering ao ON ao.class_id = tc.id JOIN assignment_template at ON at.id = ao.template_id JOIN student_assignment sa ON sa.offering_id = ao.id AND sa.student_id = sp.id WHERE sp.student_no COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = #{studentNo} COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND sp.status <> 'DELETED' AND ao.id = #{offeringId} AND ao.status <> 'ARCHIVED'

SELECT ap.sort_order AS sortOrder, ap.problem_no AS problemNo, ap.title AS problemTitle, ap.statement_md AS statementMd, sps.latest_status AS latestStatus, sps.best_score AS bestScore, sps.attempt_count AS attemptCount, latest_attempt.submitted_at AS submitTime, code_artifact.text_content AS code FROM student_profile sp JOIN student_problem_state sps ON sps.student_id = sp.id AND sps.offering_id = #{offeringId} JOIN assignment_problem ap ON ap.id = sps.problem_id AND ap.offering_id = sps.offering_id LEFT JOIN student_problem_attempt latest_attempt ON latest_attempt.id = sps.latest_attempt_id LEFT JOIN artifact code_artifact ON code_artifact.id = sps.latest_code_artifact_id WHERE sp.student_no COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = #{studentNo} COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND sp.status <> 'DELETED' ORDER BY ap.sort_order, ap.id
